title: Qingfei Jiedu Huatan formula protects against pneumonia by activating Nrf2 to suppress alveolar epithelial apoptosis.
authors: Jiang, Yuhang; Zhang, Qin; Cheng, Yumeng; Cao, Haiyang; Xing, Xiaoxiang; Shan, Baixi; Zhao, Peng; Li, Jiansheng
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过激活Nrf2抑制肺泡上皮凋亡保护肺炎，虽含分子对接与MD分析Nrf2结合，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Qingfei Jiedu Huatan Formula (QJHF) has demonstrated efficacy in reducing the clinical stabilization time for pneumonia patients, decreasing ICU durations, and enhancing patients' quality of life. OBJECTIVE: Protecting the alveolar epithelial barrier is a proven strategy for improving pneumonia outcomes. This study aims to investigate the protective effects and underlying mechanisms of QJHF on the alveolar epithelial barrier in pneumonia. METHODS: A mouse model of pneumonia and acute lung injury was established via tracheal instillation of Klebsiella pneumoniae and LPS to evaluate the therapeutic effects of QJHF. Additionally, a TNF-alpha-induced alveolar epithelial cell barrier injury model was employed to explore the molecular mechanisms underlying QJHF's protective effects. Transcriptomics combined with network analysis was utilized to identify the active components and mechanisms of action for QJHF. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics analyses elucidated the binding interactions between Ginsenoside Rb1 (GRb1) and target proteins, while the application of Nrf2 inhibitor and siRNA clarified the role of Nrf2 activation in GRb1-mediated alveolar barrier protection. RESULTS: QJHF significantly ameliorates Klebsiella pneumoniae-induced pneumonia in mice by improving lung tissue damage, reducing inflammatory cell infiltration, and decreasing levels of pro-inflammatory factors such as TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6. Additionally, QJHF upregulates the expression of cell junction proteins ZO-1 and OCLN, thereby protecting the alveolar epithelial barrier. Similarly, QJHF mitigates LPS-induced lung damage, inflammation, and alveolar epithelial barrier dysfunction. Through integrating serum component profiling, network pharmacology, and lung transcriptomics revealed that 12 constituents in QJHF may interact with Nrf2 to modulate oxidative stress and apoptosis signaling pathways. Both in vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate that GRb1, one of the 12 components, significantly protects against TNF-alpha-induced alveolar epithelial cell barrier dysfunction and LPS-induced lung inflammation and alveolar barrier damage in mice. Furthermore, GRb1 can inhibit TNF-alpha-induced ROS levels and apoptosis in alveolar epithelial cells. Molecular dynamics stimulation and luciferase assays demonstrate that GRb1 can bind to and activate Nrf2, promoting its interaction with antioxidant response elements. Additionally, rotenone can counteract the protective effect against apoptosis in the alveolar epithelial cell barrier by increasing cellular ROS levels. Similarly, siRNA can significantly impair GRb1's protective effects against TNF-alpha-induced damage to the alveolar epithelial cell barrier. Nrf2 inhibitors notably attenuated GRb1's amelioration of LPS-induced lung inflammation and alveolar barrier damage in mice. CONCLUSION: This study confirms that QJHF and its active component GRb1 can activate Nrf2 to inhibit oxidative stress and apoptosis in alveolar epithelial cells, thereby protecting the alveolar epithelial barrier and ameliorating pulmonary inflammation and damage in mice with pneumonia.
abstract_zh: 背景：清肺解毒化痰方（QJHF）已被证明能有效缩短肺炎患者临床稳定时间、减少重症监护室停留时长，并提升患者生活质量。目的：保护肺泡上皮屏障是改善肺炎预后的公认策略。本研究旨在探讨QJHF对肺炎中肺泡上皮屏障的保护作用及其潜在机制。方法：通过气管滴注肺炎克雷伯菌和LPS建立肺炎及急性肺损伤小鼠模型，以评估QJHF的治疗效果。此外，采用TNF-α诱导的肺泡上皮细胞屏障损伤模型，探索QJHF保护作用的分子机制。结合转录组学与网络分析，鉴定QJHF的活性成分及作用机制。分子对接和分子动力学分析阐明了人参皂苷Rb1（GRb1）与靶蛋白的结合相互作用，而Nrf2抑制剂和siRNA的应用则明确了Nrf2激活在GRb1介导的肺泡屏障保护中的作用。结果：QJHF显著改善肺炎克雷伯菌诱导的小鼠肺炎，通过减轻肺组织损伤、减少炎症细胞浸润，并降低TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6等促炎因子水平。此外，QJHF上调细胞连接蛋白ZO-1和OCLN的表达，从而保护肺泡上皮屏障。同样，QJHF缓解了LPS诱导的肺损伤、炎症及肺泡上皮屏障功能障碍。通过整合血清成分谱、网络药理学和肺转录组学，发现QJHF中的12种成分可能通过与Nrf2相互作用来调节氧化应激和凋亡信号通路。体外和体内研究均表明，GRb1（这12种成分之一）显著保护TNF-α诱导的肺泡上皮细胞屏障功能障碍，以及LPS诱导的小鼠肺部炎症和肺泡屏障损伤。此外，GRb1能抑制TNF-α诱导的肺泡上皮细胞中ROS水平和凋亡。分子动力学模拟和荧光素酶实验表明，GRb1能结合并激活Nrf2，促进其与抗氧化反应元件的相互作用。同时，鱼藤酮能通过增加细胞ROS水平来抵消对肺泡上皮细胞屏障凋亡的保护作用。类似地，siRNA能显著削弱GRb1对TNF-α诱导的肺泡上皮细胞屏障损伤的保护作用。Nrf2抑制剂显著减弱了GRb1对LPS诱导的小鼠肺部炎症和肺泡屏障损伤的改善作用。结论：本研究证实，QJHF及其活性成分GRb1能激活Nrf2以抑制肺泡上皮细胞的氧化应激和凋亡，从而保护肺泡上皮屏障，并改善肺炎小鼠的肺部炎症和损伤。
